name: Huru Calendar
author: Hurunagus
description: iCloud agenda on the Omarchy bar: the next event beside the clock, and a popup with the days ahead. Reads the hcal daemon over IPC, so nothing but the daemon (pure Go) has to run.

barWidget.description: Next event on the bar and the coming days in the popup, from iCloud via the hcal daemon (hcal ipc events.list).

schema.label: Days ahead
schema.description: How far the popup looks ahead.

schema.label: Show the next event's time beside the icon
